title: Section Misconceptions File
description: Canonical contract for *.misconceptions.json. The canonical shape is an OBJECT {section_id, misconceptions:[...]}. A bare top-level ARRAY is a legacy defect and is rejected. Each item must carry a non-null rail_action from the allowed rail set. The legacy item variant (claim/reality/whyItHappens/coachPrompt with no rail_action) is rejected so the validator flags the items needing backfill.
